scoring_notes: Quality dominant (0.45) — box construction material, joinery method, and finish type are the primary differentiators. Durability (0.30) covers hardware lifespan (drawer slides, hinges) and moisture resistance. Performance (0.25) covers functional aspects (soft-close, adjustability, load capacity).

calibration_products.name: Crystal Keyline (custom)
calibration_products.rationale: Minnesota custom shop. All 3/4" plywood construction. Solid hardwood dovetail drawer boxes. Catalyzed conversion varnish finish. Blum hinges (165K cycles) and TANDEM slides (100K cycles, 130 lb). Single-source manufacturing. KCMA certified. Rutt/Plain & Fancy tier per Main Line Kitchen Design ratings (A quality).

calibration_products.name: Fabuwood Galaxy
calibration_products.scoring_note: Spec engine derives Q=93, D=94, P=90 → composite=93. Crystal/Fabuwood parity on composite is correct — distinction lives in axis split (Crystal higher Q from CV finish; Fabuwood higher D from Blum parity with catalyzed lacquer durability).
calibration_products.rationale: New Jersey manufacturer. Plywood box construction. Baltic birch dovetail drawer boxes. Blum TANDEM undermount slides and Clip top Blumotion hinges. Catalyzed lacquer finish. Single-source. KCMA certified. Pro consensus: best value at premium tier — Galaxy line specifically, not Allure/Nexus.

calibration_products.name: KraftMaid (base config)
calibration_products.rationale: MasterBrand/Fortune Brands. Dominant semi-custom. Particleboard box (furniture-board grade). Blum hinges and slides (lower-spec than custom). Catalyzed CV finish. J.D. Power #2 satisfaction. B+ quality per Main Line. Pros specify for mid-range remodels. Platform sharing with Diamond/Merillat but KraftMaid gets better hardware.

calibration_products.name: IKEA SEKTION
calibration_products.rationale: European frameless design. Particleboard box. RTA assembly (cam lock). Key advantage: confirmed Blum MAXIMERA drawer system (undermount, soft-close). TFL finish (thermofoil risk). 25-year limited warranty. J.D. Power high customer satisfaction BUT pros rate D quality per Main Line — thermofoil peels by year 5, drawers fail. Multi-source manufacturing. Target reduced from 71 to 68 based on installer feedback.

calibration_products.name: Merillat Classic
calibration_products.rationale: MasterBrand builder-grade line. Particleboard box. Generic drawer slides (35K cycles, 75 lb). Blum hinges but lower spec. Catalyzed lacquer finish. KCMA certified (positive). No soft-close standard. Platform shares with KraftMaid/Diamond but gets lowest-tier components.

calibration_products.name: Hampton Bay (Home Depot)
calibration_products.rationale: Home Depot house brand. Lowest-density particleboard. Generic hinges (30K cycles). Generic drawer slides (25K cycles, 50 lb). Thermofoil or melamine finish. No soft-close. Multi-source import manufacturing. Pros universally refuse for quality installs. Reported 5-7 year total failure. Reduced from Timberlake Origins (52) to Hampton Bay (45) as true builder-grade floor based on new research.

platform_disclosures: MasterBrand Cabinets (Fortune Brands): KraftMaid, Diamond, Merillat, Decora, Omega, Aristockraft, Homecrest share factories. Higher lines get better hardware and materials from same plants.
American Woodmark: Waypoint, Timberlake, Shenandoah — platform sharing confirmed, differentiated primarily by door style and finish options.
Fabuwood: Galaxy/Allure/Nexus are distinct quality tiers from same NJ factory. Galaxy = plywood+Blum. Allure = mixed. Nexus = budget.
